name: What's the difference between an undermount and a drop-in sink?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between an undermount and a drop-in sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: An undermount sink is installed beneath the countertop, creating a seamless look and making countertop cleaning easier as crumbs can be wiped directly into the sink. A drop-in (or top-mount) sink has a rim that rests on top of the countertop, supporting its weight and simplifying installation. Undermount sinks are generally perceived as more modern and require a solid surface countertop, while drop-in sinks are versatile and work with various countertop materials, often at a lower installation cost.
acceptedAnswer.description: Undermount sinks are installed beneath the counter for a seamless look, while drop-in sinks rest on top with a visible rim.
